---
name: Compliance question
about: Ask how Don't-Lie receipts satisfy a specific regulation or audit requirement.
title: "[compliance] "
labels: compliance, question
assignees: []
---

## Regulation or framework

(e.g. EU AI Act Article 12, HIPAA Security Rule §164.312, SOC 2 CC7.2, NY DFS
500.02, ISO 42001 A.6.2.6, NIST AI RMF MEASURE, FedRAMP AC-2, BAA §164.504(e),
Colorado SB 24-205 ADMT, FDA PCCP, CFPB UDAAP)

## What you need to demonstrate

The exact audit or regulatory question you're answering. Quote the regulatory
text if you can.

## Current evidence

What you already have (signed receipts, witness attestations, etc.) and what
is missing.

## How Don't-Lie can help

- See [docs/compliance/](../../tree/main/docs/compliance) for the per-regime memos.
- The most-requested memos are: `EUAIAct.md`, `HIPAA.md`, `SOC2.md`, `NYDFS.md`,
  `BAA-TEMPLATE.md`, `FedRAMP.md`, `CFPB.md`, `ColoradoADMT.md`, `FDAPCCP.md`.

## What you do NOT need

This is a question channel, not a feature request. If you want a new
compliance memo written, use the `[feature]` template and tag it
"compliance".

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Cited memo path or "no existing memo — see [feature]".
- [ ] Linked to the exact receipt type or vault field that backs the claim.
- [ ] If a new compliance memo is needed, a companion feature issue is opened.
